mission_08: Depthwise separable convolution first applies a spatial filter independently to each input channel (depthwise), then mixes channels with a 1x1 pointwise convolution.
Batch normalization normalizes activations across the batch and spatial dimensions: (x - mean) / sqrt(var + epsilon), followed by ReLU.
The sliding window approach classifies each window independently and collects detections where the maximum class probability exceeds the confidence threshold.
